title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
authors: J. Shah, G. Bikshandi, Y. Zhang, et al. (6 authors)
before: FlashAttention-2 was tuned for the previous GPU generation.
problem: Hopper GPUs have asynchronous copy engines and FP8 units that the older kernel left idle.
breakthrough: Overlap computation with data movement and exploit low precision, roughly doubling attention throughput on H100s.
why: Attention kernels are now co-designed with each GPU generation, and this is the current reference implementation.
next: Folded into serving stacks and the training runs of most 2024 and 2025 models.
inherits: Hardware-specific attention kernels as standard infrastructure.
